When KatNip® isn't enough, go big. Lion, tiger, liger or tigon, with the reflexes to match. Biotechnica sells it as the peak of the feline form, and the Animals treat it as a promotion.

Package: Major
Humanity Loss: 38
Includes: Adrenaline Convertor, Combat Jaw, Cybereye ×2 w/ LL/IR/UV, Cyberleg ×2 w/ Grip Foot ×2, Jump Booster ×2 and Lynx Paws, Grafted Muscle and Bone Lace ×2, Kerenzikov, Sandevistan, Wolvers ×2

Install the pieces it includes as cyberware; the package price covers them all.

Item Compendium (2070) • Cyberware
